Are you looking for a fun and dynamic job where you can truly make a difference in logistics?As an Order Picker and Packer at GXO Logistics in Tilburg, you play an essential role in keeping the warehouse running smoothly together with your team. No two days are the same, and your tasks will vary depending on the department you work in.

Online departments

- Picking: You collect products using a scanner and ensure each order contains the correct items before sending them to packing.
- Packing: At a packing station, you scan items, check that orders are complete, and prepare packages for shipment, including printing labels.
- Returns: You inspect returned items for quality and process them correctly, ensuring they are restocked or sent back to the supplier when needed.

You’ll be part of a friendly, international team where communication and teamwork are key. Together, you make sure every order is processed quickly and accurately, so customers receive their orders with a smile.

Retail department

- PBR (Retail operations): In this department, you handle products intended for in-store use. You can be trained in multiple processes, including Picking, Receiving, Put-Away, Allocation, Inbound, and Outbound.

Here, you’ll work in a close-knit team, ensuring that all products are handled with care and efficiency from the moment they arrive at the warehouse until they are shipped to stores.

Hard requirements

- You can communicate in English (minimum B1 level).
- You are physically fit and able to stand and walk for extended periods.
- You are available to work either a fixed morning shift or in a two-shift rotation.
- You have your own accommodation and transportation.
- You are able to apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).
- You are available full-time and can work from Monday to Saturday in 2 shifts.

Working hours:

Morning shift 06:00 – 14:45 and Afternoon shift 15:15 – 00:00

Ready to start a new job?

Looking for an active warehouse job?

Start your next job at GXO Logistics in Tilburg!

Work in a modern warehouse with an international team. You will pick, pack, and ship customer orders correctly and on time.

No warehouse experience? That's okay! If you are motivated, willing to learn, and like to stay active, we will train you and help you grow.

Please note: This is an active, physical job. You'll be walking, standing and moving throughout your shift.

What will you do?

As a Warehouse Employee, you can work in different departments.

Order Picking

- Pick products using a hand scanner.
- Collect the correct items for customer orders.
- Make sure orders are complete.

Packing

- Scan products.
- Check orders before shipment.
- Print shipping labels.

Returns

- Inspect returned products.
- Decide whether products can be returned to stock.
- Process returns in the warehouse system.

Together with your colleagues, you'll ensure every product is handled carefully from the moment it arrives until it leaves the warehouse.

What do we ask?

- You speak and understand basic English (minimum B1).
- You are available full-time or part-time.
- You enjoy active work and are physically fit.
- You can stand and walk throughout your shift.
- You have your own accommodation and transportation.
- You can apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).

Working hours in aTwo-shift system

Morning: 06:00 - 14:45

Afternoon: 15:15 - 00:00

Are you technically skilled, do you enjoy challenges and variety, and would you like to work is a modern, clean production environment where there is always something happening? For a dynamic company specializing in sorting and packaging fresh blueberries, we are looking for a motivated quality control employee in Horst. In a modern, refrigerated working environment, you will work with advanced sorting machines to guarantee top quality. 
What do we offer? - A gross hourly wage between €16.64 and €19.41 depending on experience; - 25% bonus for evening shifts (7 p.m. - 11 p.m.); - Variable working hours from 06:00 - 14:00 or 11:45 - 20:00, sometimes until 23:00 during peak season; - Travel allowance; - Prospect of a permanent contract; - A close-knit team and a pleasant working atmosphere. 
What will you do? 
As a quality control officer, you are responsible for the quality of incoming and outgoing batches of blueberries. You will work closely with production, logistics and sourcing teams to ensure that everything meets our high quality standards. Your duties will include: - Checking and registering batches in the quality registration system; - Performing visual and physical quality checks; - Taking samples and performing shelf life tests; - Monitoring hygiene in the workplace; - Identifying deviations and areas for improvement; - Working with AI-controlled sorting machines. 
What will you bring - Minimum vocational education and thinking level; - Affinity with fresh products and quality control; - Good command of Dutch and English (Polish is an advantage); - Flexible attitude and independent working style; - Available for 40 hours per week in staggered day shifts. 
Are you interested and would you like to apply? Then contact us now by phone on +31 6 24436668, send a Whatsapp message or email to info@durabelrecruitment.nl.

jobs.description:
The Korean word Samsung translates to "three stars". This reflects to the vision of the founder of the company. A company that is continously growing, improving and will always be a very strong brand. At Samsung SDS we support this vision by assisting Samsung by fullfilling a large part of their supply chain. In our Warehouse in Tilburg, we make sure that different items as tv's, microwaves and vacuumcleaners, washing machines and refridgerators are correctly distributed to their customers. During the day, trucks come in to be unloaded and loaded. The items that come in, need to be checked, put in the right place and prepared for loading. 

Right now, we are looking for:

- Reachtruck drivers to assist in Picking and Putaway
- Forklift and Clamp Drivers to assist loading and unloading
- Warehouse Operators for preparing pallets for transport
- Pickers (please be aware that the items that need to be picked are larger items such as tv's and soundbars)

All this is being done in two shifts. A morning shift from 06.00 to 14.30 and and evening shift from 14.30 to 23.00. You will be working both shifts. It is not possible to work in only one. 

When you are hired as a driver you will also be expected to help with other tasks that need to be done. You will not only be on the forklift of reachtruck.

You enjoy working in an international environment and love to work hard. At Samsung SDS, you'll help keep everything running smoothly in the warehouse.

What you bring:

- You have your own transportation to get to work. Since you'll be working in shifts, public transport is NOT possible!
- You speak and understand English, which is needed in this international environment. This can be tested during the tour!
- You are available full-time and can work both shifts
- You are fit enough for physical work.
- You have your own accommodation. We do NOT provide it!
- You are available for a longer period of time.

It is prefered that you are flexible. Sometimes we work until 1 a.

For one of our clients near Eindhoven, we are looking for new colleagues for the position of Repair / Assembly Employee Industrial Packaging. In this role, you will be responsible for various tasks, allowing you to support multiple departments when needed. You will join a team of approximately 20 colleagues, supported by 2 shift leaders. Depending on the department where you start, your tasks may include:

- Inspecting incoming packaging using a checklist; you will also determine whether it should be sent to the technical repair department or the maintenance department
- Repairing aluminium and/or wooden packaging; this may include carpentry work, assembling new parts, removing dents, etc.
- Replacing corner profiles, handles, and wheels

In this position, you will work in a two-shift schedule. One week you will work Monday through Friday from 06:00 AM to 03:00 PM, and the following week from 03:00 PM to 00:00 at night.

For this reason, it is important that you have your own transportation, as public transport is not available during these hours.

- You have a good command of the English language, both spoken and written
- You possess technical insight
- You are proactive and able to identify work independently
- You can work well in an environment that is somewhat less organized

Do you want to work as a Production Worker in the food production industry in Zoetermeer? In this role as Production Worker, you and your colleagues help produce and package meat products. You work in a modern production environment where hygiene and quality are important. As a Production Worker, your work is varied and the results of your work are visible right away.

What you get in this job

- Hands-on work in a production environment
- Working together with colleagues in a close team
- The chance to learn different production tasks
- Opportunities to grow into roles such as machine operator

Your shift starts early in the morning in the production area. You check in with your team and get ready for the day’s production. Together you make sure everything runs smoothly so the products are processed and packed on time. Because the company works with fresh products, flexibility during the workday is important.

As a Production Worker, your tasks include:

- Packing products so they are ready for transport
- Working in different departments such as production or seasoning
- Operating and maintaining production machines
- Keeping your workspace clean and safe
- Thinking along about improvements in the production process

You enjoy practical work and like working with colleagues to create products people enjoy.

Enjoying practical work and being part of a team is important for this role.

Requirements:

- Availability for at least 4 days per week
- Ability to communicate in Dutch and/or English
- Ability to work in a food production environment

Preferred:

- Previous experience in production work
- Interest in working with machines
- Accurate and hygienic way of working

Start Your Logistics Career at Rhenus

Looking for a full-time warehouse position in day shifts and a supportive team? Join Rhenus as a Logistics Employee and play an important role in keeping our daily operations running smoothly.

What will you do?

- Load and unload incoming and outgoing goods
- Check products for quality and accuracy
- Pick, pack, and prepare orders for shipment
- Prepare shipments for dispatch
- Assemble and dismantle wooden crates
- Work closely with your team to keep operations running efficiently

Working hours Monday: to Friday, 07:00–16:00 or 08:00–17:00 Immediate start possible

Who we’re looking for:

- You speak Dutch and/or English fluently
- You are motivated, reliable, and eager to develop your skills
- You have some experience in logistics or warehouse work
- You are physically fit and comfortable with active tasks
- You are available full-time (40 hours per week)

Are you at your best in the morning and looking for an active part-time job that's easy to combine with your studies, family, or other activities? Then we have a great opportunity for you! We're looking for a part-time order picker for the AS Watson warehouse in Ede who's eager to roll up their sleeves and ensure orders are shipped correctly and on time.

What will you be doing?

As an order picker, you're a key link in the logistics process. Thanks to your dedication, customers of Kruidvat and Trekpleister, among others, receive their online orders quickly and efficiently. Your duties include:
• Picking orders using a scanner and headset
• Checking for correct quantities and items
• Carefully packaging orders
• Selecting the right packaging material and applying the correct labels
• Performing a final check before the order is shipped.

You work part-time in a shift from 07:00 - 16:00. 

Flexibility is important; you are available at least one Saturday every four weeks (it is not guarranteed that you have to work every four weeks on Saturday). 

- Experience as an order picker is an advantage, but certainly not a requirement
- You are a real team player
- You speak Dutch and/or English
- You are physically able to perform active work
- You are flexible and can work part-time, including the occasional Saturday

Are you looking for a stable full-time position with fixed daytime hours from Monday to Friday? Join the Packaging department at Rhenus and help ensure medical products are processed and prepared safely and efficiently.

Your responsibilities:

- Load and unload incoming and outgoing deliveries
- Perform quality checks on products
- Pick, pack, and prepare orders
- Prepare shipments for safe and timely transport
- Assemble and disassemble wooden crates

Your work plays an important role in keeping daily operations running smoothly and ensuring medical supplies are delivered accurately, safely, and on time.

Who we’re looking for:

- You are able to communicate in Dutch and/or English
- You are reliable, motivated, and eager to learn
- You have some experience in logistics
- You are available full-time (40 hours per week)

Do you enjoy working in a logistics environment and like having a variety of tasks?
For our client in Deurne, we are looking for motivated EPT Operators / Order Pickers.

After enjoying a cup of coffee or tea, you and your colleagues will start the workday. You will be responsible for a variety of tasks within the warehouse, including:

- Picking, checking, collecting, and preparing orders for shipment
- Wrapping and scanning pallets
- Moving goods and pallets using an EPT (Electric Pallet Truck)
- Lifting boxes weighing up to 23 kg
- Operating reach trucks, combi trucks, and forklifts

In addition, you may occasionally be assigned other warehouse-related tasks, such as applying stickers and labels, repacking products, inflating balls, and performing other general warehouse duties.

Who are you?

- You are flexible and do not mind working in a two-shift schedule.
- You live in the region of Deurne, Helmond, Weert, Venray, or Peel en Maas.
- You speak Dutch or English.

We offer stable work for roofers from the Eindhoven region! Are you ready for a new challenge and do you want to be part of a team where dedication, craftsmanship and a good mood are central? We are waiting for you! What are you going to do? 
Every day you work on beautiful roofing projects that require craftsmanship and precision. No day is the same and every roof is a new challenge. You are part of a team that works together to achieve the best results for customers. Your daily tasks include installing and maintaining roofs, ensuring high-quality craftsmanship and working with other team members. You travel with your colleagues (a group of 2-3 people) in a company van to the location. What do we offer you? - Salary from € 17.50 per hour (depending on your experience). - Wide range of training opportunities. - An average of 20 days ADV and 25 vacation days per year. - Tools and work materials of top quality. - Working hours are from 7:30 to 16:00. excluding travel time, in the summer you leave earlier because of the warm weather. - An open and informal working atmosphere where hard work goes hand in hand with conviviality, because a healthy dose of humor is essential here! - After a certain period there is a prospect of a permanent contract with a renowned company. What do you need? - You like the freedom that comes with working on a roof and have experience with the best materials. - You are someone who values punctuality and an eye for detail. - You have at least 1 year of experience as a roofer of bituminous, PVC and EPDM flat roofs. - You have a VCA diploma or want to obtain one. - You can work in a team and adapt to the instructions of the foreman. - Working in the field is a pleasure for you and a driving license B is a plus. - You speak the English language. Dutch is a plus 
Kasia Szwarc can tell you everything about it! - kasia@wenabv.com

Are you looking for...

As a Maintenance Handyman, you will make sure our warehouse, facilities and surrounding areas are kept safe, functional and well-maintained.

Your tasks will include:

- Carrying out small repairs and maintenance jobs throughout the company.
- Repairing and maintaining lockers, doors and other facilities.
- Helping to keep the warehouse and surrounding grounds in good condition.
- Identifying maintenance issues and solving them where possible.
- Supporting colleagues with various practical tasks.

Every day is different, so you won't be sitting behind a desk. It's an active and varied job where you are constantly on the move and working with your hands.

We are looking for someone who:

- Is practical and enjoys fixing and making things.
- Has basic technical knowledge and is comfortable using tools.
- Is proactive and can work independently.
- Is reliable and takes pride in their work.
- Enjoys an active working environment.
- Can communicate in English, Spanish or Romanian.
- Previous experience in maintenance, construction, facility services or a similar role is a plus, but not required.
